title: Fried cocoy banana
hookLine: Global-inspired fried cocoy banana with 5 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Whisk & Combine Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix eggs and cinnamon in a bowl. Keep {m53572_1}, {m53572_2}, {m53572_3}, and {m53572_4} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure cinnamon first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Dip cocoy in mixture, then coat in the panko breadcrumbs. Gently press the coating onto every side so it adheres evenly, then let excess drip off before transferring to a clean tray. Incorporate {m53572_5} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Heat Oil to 350°F (175°C)
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat oil at medium heat. Bring the oil to 350°F (175°C) over medium heat—you can test readiness by dipping the handle of a wooden spoon and looking for steady, gentle bubbles.

steps.title: Fry Until Golden & Crisp
steps.instructionTemplate: Place cocoy in hot oil. Work in small batches so the oil temperature stays steady, frying for 2–3 minutes per side until deeply golden and crisp all around.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Garnish & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Remove from pan when golden brown. Drain briefly on a wire cooling rack lined with paper towels for 1–2 minutes so the outside stays shatteringly crisp, then plate into 4 servings and enjoy warm.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 8 mins!
